ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Foods/Feeding PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Plants ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Animals ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Weather ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
